items.source_en:
From: Azad Dubas

Hello, my sweet. I hope the early phases of your project are going well.

I'll be sending a message to Fihran today. I found some more issues with the structural housing at the bottom of the elevator shaft. It's nothing too serious, mostly just a patch job, really. He's been keeping very busy lately, what with the lack of hands to do the repair work. Yet another reminder of what we recently lost, I suppose. 

May the Great Serpent be merciful and guide us safely out of these difficult days.

items.source_en:
A few weeks ago, while I was working near the southern gate, I saw several kids playing around while climbing a small cliff. It got me thinking... there are so many challenging climbs on Korriban. I should head out and find some cliffs of my own to climb and author a guide about my experience!

I'm going to talk to my partner tonight about my idea. Hopefully, they'll be as excited as I am! I haven't climbed since I was a kid. I can't wait!

items.source_en:
Someone will need to go beyond the camp and scout out our surroundings. 

We have seen activity nearby with what looks like Zealots down the hill. A ship seems to be coming in and out every now and then. 

Head down there and take a better look. Report back if there is anything of use we can take or (less likely) there might somehow be a way to work with them.

We'll provide you some resources so you won't have to climb up and down the hill.
items.legacy_ko:
누군가 캠프 바깥으로 나가서 주변을 정찰해야 할 것 같다.

그곳으로 가서 자세히 살펴보도록. 우리가 챙길 만한 것이 있거나 (가능성은 낮지만) 서로 협력할 방법이 있는지 확인해 줘. 

언덕을 오르내릴 필요가 없도록 몇 가지 자원도 제공해 주지.
